title: Evicted Spanish pensioner who sparked housing protests has died, Madrid tenant union says
summary: Maricarmen ⁠Abascal, the octogenarian woman whose eviction set off housing protests across Spain, has died, a tenant's union in Madrid has said.

image.caption: Maricarmen Abascal was 87 years oldImage: Francesco Militello Mirto/NurPhoto/picture alliance

blocks.text: "We are sorry to announce that Maricarmen passed away today," the Madrid Tenants' Union said in a statement about Maricarmen Abascal, adding that her cause marked "a turning point in the history of this country."
